title: Explicit simple gl_n(C) modules from generic Gelfand-Tsetlin tableaux with fixed nonnegative integral adjacent-row differences
author: Vyacheslav Futorny; Dimitar Grantcharov; Luis Enrique Ramirez
source_title: Irreducible Generic Gelfand-Tsetlin Modules of gl(n)
difficulty_reason: The construction needs a global reachability proof for arbitrary integral tableau shifts preserving adjacent-row inequalities. The author controls maximal chains across rows, isolates basis components by the commutative Gelfand-Tsetlin algebra and identifies the maximal proper quotient, yielding a simple module with an explicit tableau basis for all heights.
source_version: Official SIGMA 11 (2015) article 018, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2015.018; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256

proof_review.method: Published author proof/core and local context fidelity screening
proof_review.note: Complete Section6 proof read, including the chain-selection Lemma6.3, generator reachability induction Theorem6.8 and the proper-submodule quotient in Theorem6.14. Generic means within each row below the top, distinct entries differ by no integer; top row is fixed and all lower entries change by integers. The selected basis comprises exactly tableaux whose Omega-plus set of nonnegative integral adjacent-row differences equals that of the starting tableau. Standard Gelfand-Tsetlin formulas and generic multiplicity-one construction are explicitly published background in Theorem5.2; component separation and unique generic simple module are supplied in Section5. The parameter-space equivalence-relation classification in the final sentence and later block counts are excluded.

statement_scope: Only the explicit simple-module and tableau-basis conclusions of Theorem6.14, with generic within-row differences nonintegral below the fixed top row. The module is the quotient of U*T(R) by the sum of its proper tableau-generated submodules; basis I(T(R)) consists of integral lower-row shifts with Omega-plus unchanged, and the induced Gelfand-Tsetlin action is that of the quotient. The final parameter-space quotient classification and Section7 counts are not selected.
source_boundary_note: Only the full original explicit simple-module/tableau-basis conclusions of main Theorem 6.14 are selected; the final parameter-space classification sentence and its closing argument are excluded without alteration. All required generic multiplicity-one/component separation, unique simple-module construction, maximal-chain selection and full generator-reachability induction are supplied. The quotient by the sum of proper tableau-generated submodules has exactly the source Omega-plus-equality basis and induced Gelfand–Tsetlin formulas. Standard classical/generic formula constructions remain cited prerequisites. The fixed top row and nonintegral within-lower-row differences are retained. No parameter quotient, generic-block count or separate reachability lemma is counted.
